# Bolton Technical South Africa

> > Premier provider of ICASA-approved cell phone signal booster solutions for homes, offices, vehicles, and enterprise installations across South Africa.

Bolton Technical specializes in WilsonPro and weBoost signal booster systems, offering comprehensive solutions for improving cellular connectivity in residential, commercial, and mobile environments. The company provides complete kits, components, and professional-grade amplification systems tailored to South African telecommunications standards.
